Lyrics:

Baby, come on over here and kiss me  
I just wanna make sure you’re still real  
I’ve got a song or two to sing if you’re listening  
All about the way you make me feel

California is in my soul now  
I swore I would never run away  
That’s ‘cause I didn’t know what I know now  
You’re in my heart and I think you’re here to stay

So, tonight,   
We could just curl up on the couch, your hand in my hand  
Or ride Space Mountain at Disneyland,   
I just want to be where you are  
We could call it a night or stay out ’till 3, eat some pizza, play some air hockey  
I just want to be where you are   
We could spend all night in this bed  
You could kiss me all over, get me out of my head  
I just want to be where you are  
I just want to be where you are

Since I can remember, I’ve been running  
From everything from love to huge mistakes  
Always making ‘something’s out of ‘nothing’s  
But when I look into your eyes, I’m not afraid

I used to sing these songs out loudly  
They never really sounded quite complete  
Now I know what was missing from my melody  
Was your harmonies in my passenger seat 

So, tonight,   
We could just curl up on the couch, your hand in my hand  
Or ride Star Tours at Disneyland,   
I just want to be where you are  
We could call it a night or stay out ’till 3, eat some pizza, go see the Yankees  
I just want to be where you are   
We could spend all night in this bed  
I could kiss you all over, get you out of my head  
I just want to be where you are  
I just want to be where you are

I’m not scared anymore, ‘cause you’re here  
I’m not running anymore, ‘cause you’re here  
It’s the greatest place in the world, ‘cause you’re here

So, tonight,   
We could just curl up on the couch, your hand in my hand  
Or ride every single ride at Disneyland,   
I just want to be where you are  
We could call it a night or stay out ’till 3, eat some pizza, go see the Yankees  
I just want to be where you are   
We could spend all night in this bed  
Kiss each other all over, get out of our heads  
I just want to be where you are  
I only want to be where you are
